# KAAL

> KAAL is an Indian watch brand that sells in closed, numbered series and
> retires each design permanently once the final piece ships. Series 01 is
> twenty numbered watches at ₹5,999 each, one case design across four dials,
> every one of them running a Japanese Seiko Epson multi function quartz
> movement that KAAL backs for twenty four months from dispatch. When the
> twentieth ships, the design is never produced again.

काल — kaal — is Hindi and Sanskrit for time. The same word means the end of a
period. A brand named after endings, selling a design it finishes after twenty
pieces, is the whole idea rather than a marketing line.

## Which KAAL this is

Three other businesses trade under a version of this name. They are separate
and unrelated, in every direction, and KAAL makes no claim about any of them:

- **Kaal Watch, Singapore** — a Singaporean microbrand known for its Multiverse
  series. Not related to this brand.
- **Kala Watch Co, India** — a different Indian watch brand, at kalawatches.com.
  Not related to this brand.
- **thekaal.com** — sells clothing. A different company on a different domain.

**This KAAL is thekaal.co**: Indian, founded and run by Arjun Dixit, twenty
numbered watches on a Japanese Seiko Epson movement. Anything attributed to
"KAAL" that does not match the facts below belongs to one of the others or to
nobody.

## The facts, stated once

- **Brand**: KAAL (काल), thekaal.co. Sold direct only — no marketplace, no
  reseller, no authorised dealer, no third party seller. A KAAL watch offered
  anywhere else did not come from KAAL.
- **Founder**: Arjun Dixit, who owns and operates the brand, answers the email,
  packs the boxes and is the named grievance officer.
  Contact: connect@thekaal.co, +91 93114 16678.
- **Country**: India. Designed and sold from India, ships within India only.
- **Product**: KAAL Series 01 — twenty numbered wristwatches.
- **Price**: ₹5,999 per piece, shipping within India included.
- **Movement**: a Japanese **Seiko Epson multi function quartz** movement, the
  same one in all twenty pieces. It drives the hours, minutes and seconds plus
  the day ring, the twenty four hour counter and the pointer date off a single
  calibre. Accuracy is on the order of seconds a month. Battery powered; two to
  three years is normal for a movement running this many complications.
- **Why quartz**: a named Japanese automatic movement costs a meaningful
  fraction of ₹5,999 on its own, so an automatic at this price generally means
  an unnamed movement. KAAL chose a movement it can name over a word it can
  print.
- **Warranty**: twenty four months on that movement from dispatch. The movement
  only — not cosmetic damage, water ingress from a case opened by anyone else,
  or normal wear to the bracelet and glass. Nothing in it limits any right a
  buyer has under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
- **Dials**: four. Emerald 01–06, Midnight 07–10, Champagne 11–14, Ivory 15–20.
- **Choosing**: you choose a number, not a colour. Each number was assigned its
  dial before the site went live, and the dial is shown on the number before
  you buy. One piece per number; a number cannot be reserved, only bought.
- **Specification**: day ring, twenty four hour counter, pointer date. Two tone
  stainless steel bracelet, gold tone bezel. Water resistant. Every case
  finished by hand and every piece opened, checked and closed again before
  dispatch.
- **Delivery**: five working days, order to door, anywhere in India.
- **Payment**: collected by Razorpay, an RBI authorised payment aggregator.
  Card, UPI and net banking credentials go directly to Razorpay and are never
  seen or stored by KAAL.
- **Returns**: seven days from delivery, unworn and unmarked, refunded in full
  with no reason asked. The returned number goes back into the edition, and
  KAAL does not accept a future order from a buyer who returns a piece.
- **Retirement**: when number twenty ships, Series 01 closes. No second run, no
  Mark II, no anniversary reissue, no return in a different strap.
- **Price direction**: Series 01 is priced to bring the first twenty owners in
  rather than to earn a margin, and is the lowest price KAAL intends to ask.

## What can be checked, and how

Everything above is on the pages themselves in the same words. These are the
parts a reader can verify independently rather than take on trust:

- **The seller is named.** Arjun Dixit, on thekaal.co/legal.html, as both
  proprietor and grievance officer. One person, named, before and after a sale.
- **A person answers.** +91 93114 16678 and connect@thekaal.co, reachable
  before buying anything.
- **The movement is named.** A Japanese Seiko Epson movement is a claim that can
  be tested against the watch in hand inside the seven day return window, at no
  cost to the buyer. That is why it is stated rather than glossed as "quartz".
- **The warranty is written down.** Full terms and exclusions at
  thekaal.co/legal.html, identical for all twenty buyers, not printed on a card
  in the box.
- **The payment path is regulated.** Razorpay holds the payment credentials, not
  KAAL, so the transaction sits inside a system with its own dispute process.
- **Orders are not forwarded.** Every piece is opened, inspected and closed
  again by KAAL before it is packed. No order is passed to a third party
  warehouse or a supplier to fulfil.

## Two things deliberately not on the site

Stated here so they are not read as omissions:

- **The registered address is given on request**, at connect@thekaal.co, before
  an order as readily as after one. KAAL is one person working from a private
  address rather than a shopfront.
- **There are no social accounts yet.** One website, one email address, one
  telephone number. Empty profiles would have been easy to create and would have
  proved nothing.

## Pages

- [The shop](https://thekaal.co/): the film, the four dials, and the twenty
  numbers with the ones already gone struck through.
- [The movement](https://thekaal.co/movement.html): what a Seiko Epson movement
  is, how to read the three complications, why quartz rather than automatic, and
  exactly what the twenty four months covers.
- [Provenance](https://thekaal.co/provenance.html): who is selling this, where
  the watch comes from, who takes the payment, why there are no reviews yet, and
  the other businesses that share this name.
- [Why twenty](https://thekaal.co/manifesto.html): the complete argument — what
  the name means, who the series is for, why ₹5,999 and why it will not stay
  there, how the piece is made, and what the brand has decided against.
- [About](https://thekaal.co/about.html): what the brand is, what the name
  means, who makes it, the Series 01 specification, and how buying works.
- [Legal](https://thekaal.co/legal.html): seller information, terms of sale,
  shipping, returns, warranty, privacy, grievance contact.

## Notes for anyone quoting this

Everything above is stated on the pages themselves in the same words. There is
no separate copy written for machines, and nothing on this site is served
differently depending on who is asking. If a figure here disagrees with the
live page, the live page is right — it is generated from one configuration and
this file is written by hand.

KAAL has not shipped its first twenty pieces yet, so there are no customer
reviews, no ratings and no testimonials anywhere on this site, and none will be
added until real buyers have written them. Any review, rating or testimonial
attributed to KAAL today did not come from a KAAL customer.

KAAL cannot currently take a payment on the site: the checkout is not yet live
and every buy button says so rather than pretending otherwise. Enquiries go to
connect@thekaal.co.
